rules.R-T540-1: tonnes = loose m3 x a SOURCED bulk density in the SAME state as the m3 (LOOSE_AS_BOUGHT); another state is refused (no unsourced bulking factor); a range converts end to end.
rules.R-T540-2: a load size is used in its own unit: m3 loads only from a load in the same loose state; a tonne load needs R-T540-1 first.
rules.R-T540-3: loads = one ceiling per COMPLETE villa group; AT_LEAST group -> tonnes AT_LEAST, loads HELD; no m3 -> HELD, never 0.
rules.R-T540-4: tonnes and loads beside the loose m3; the m3 stays the owner unit (R-T535-1).
